limitations: Only m>=1/h, positive coefficients, symmetric linear migration, and deterministic two-dimensional ODE; no weak-Allee or PDE/stochastic extension. No independent external audit. Related source-sink full-text and unindexed equivalence pose a residual publication-priority risk.

title: A sharp linear-migration rescue threshold and universal critical decay in an Allee--logistic two-patch population
